title: Marketplace refresh launch plan + enablement checklist (comms, docs publish, training, monitoring readiness)
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal
- Publish refreshed AWS + GCP Marketplace listings + new SKUs with a coordinated launch plan that minimizes buyer friction and support escalations.
- Ensure internal teams (Sales/SE/CS/Support) can guide prospects through marketplace procurement and purchase→provisioning, and that we can monitor/triage entitlement/provisioning issues quickly.

Non-goals
- Rewriting full pricing/packaging or re-platforming billing (handled elsewhere; this ticket is launch orchestration + enablement only).

Primary stakeholders / owners
- PM owner (this ticket): Nikhil Sharma
- Program coordination: Talia Benson
- Listings/copy + enablement assets: Soojin Lee (+ Camila Reyes for final approval)
- Docs publication: Elliot Price (Docs lead) + Kira Thompson (TW)
- Monitoring & on-call readiness: Rafael Mendes (SRE) + Allison Grant (Observability)
- Field readiness: Markus Klein (SE) + Jordan Blake org (Sales)
- Support readiness: Dev Patel (Support) + Jasmine Liu (CS)
- Security sign-off for any externally shared packet/FAQ claims: Dr. Aisha Rahman / Marcus Lin / Olga Petrov

Deliverables
1) Launch plan (internal)
- Target launch window and cutover plan (AWS and GCP can be staggered if partner review timelines diverge).
- Go/no-go criteria and launch gates (see below).
- Roles + escalation path for launch day (SRE/Eng/Support/Partner contacts).

2) Enablement checklist (internal)
- Sales/SE training session scheduled + recording + FAQ link.
- Support macros + triage categories + escalation runbook links.
- “Buying via marketplace” one-pager / internal talk track (Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted, and when to route to direct contract).

3) Docs publication plan
- Docs publish date/time coordinated with listing go-live (and redirects/nav updates in place).
- Customer-facing FAQ published and linked from listings and console onboarding wizard.
- Verification that docs match actual console UX wording and current entitlement behavior (avoid over-promising).

4) Monitoring readiness
- Dashboards + alerts enabled for:
  - webhook ingestion failures (AWS/GCP)
  - entitlement lag timers (purchase→entitlement active)
  - provisioning error rate (org linking failures, region mismatch, duplicate org)
  - manual override/backfill actions (audit logged)
- On-call runbook: how to interpret alerts and where to find logs/traces.

Go/No-Go launch gates (draft)
- Partner review: AWS and/or GCP listing submission accepted with no remaining “must fix” feedback.
- SKU consistency: final SKU naming + IDs match ADR and internal billing plan codes (PM-873).
- Onboarding UX: Console wizard is live behind flag (or production) with correct error states and self-serve guidance (ENG-4403).
- Docs: AWS page + GCP page live with correct prerequisites, linking steps, troubleshooting (ENG-4404/ENG-4405).
- Monitoring: dashboards/alerts shipped and tested in staging with synthetic events; thresholds agreed (ENG-4407).
- Support readiness: macros + escalation rotation documented; first response SLA for marketplace onboarding tickets agreed (ENG-4409).
- Security claims: security packet / security FAQ wording signed off (Aisha/MARCUS/Olga).

Proposed timeline (working backward from target go-live)
- T-14 days: finalize launch brief + internal enablement calendar; confirm partner submission dates and expected review windows.
- T-10 days: run “tabletop exercise” for purchase→entitlement→org linking in staging with Support/SRE.
- T-7 days: Sales/SE training (30–45 mins) + office hours scheduled.
- T-5 days: docs merge + scheduled publish; screenshots verified and redacted (DES-212).
- T-3 days: monitoring thresholds tuned; create #marketplace-launch war-room channel; confirm on-call coverage.
- T-1 day: final go/no-go check; validate listing links to docs + support contacts.
- T day: enable listings / publish; monitor dashboards and triage queue.
- T+3 days: post-launch review: pipeline + activation funnel, top ticket drivers, partner feedback.

Internal comms plan
- Weekly cross-functional update (Slack: #marketplace-refresh) with:
  - partner review status
  - launch risks/blockers
  - upcoming enablement milestones
- Launch announcement (internal) on go-live morning:
  - what changed (SKUs, copy, onboarding)
  - where to find docs + FAQs
  - support/escalation path
  - known limitations and how to handle them in the field

Sales/SE enablement plan (minimum)
- Training agenda:
  1) Marketplace procurement basics (committed spend, PO/invoicing considerations)
  2) Which SKU to pick (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private; when compliance add-ons apply)
  3) Purchase→provisioning flow demo (org linking + entitlement state)
  4) Common objections + responses (security packet availability, residency language, upgrades/downgrades)
  5) What to collect from the customer if provisioning fails (account IDs, org slug, region, timestamps)
- Assets:
  - Internal deck: “Buying Redwood via Cloud Marketplaces” (outline exists)
  - Internal FAQ: top 15 questions + escalation
  - Customer-facing FAQ link (docs)

Support readiness plan
- Ticket taxonomy (initial):
  - Entitlement not active / delayed
  - Wrong org linked / can’t find org
  - Region mismatch / cannot provision in selected region
  - Billing/invoice confusion (marketplace vs direct)
  - Upgrade/downgrade questions
- Macros to draft (customer-facing):
  - “Entitlement activation can take up to X; here’s how to check + what we need if it exceeds X”
  - “How to link your marketplace purchase to a Redwood org”
  - “Region mismatch troubleshooting”
  - “Routing billing questions to marketplace provider / Redwood finance”

Monitoring & escalation plan
- War room: #marketplace-launch (go-live through T+3 days)
- Primary escalation:
  - webhook ingestion/validation failures → Ethan Park / Eng on-call (control plane)
  - entitlement lag and retries → Rafael Mendes / SRE on-call
  - console UX blockers → Chloe Martin
  - billing/metering mismatch → Cole Summers / Nadia Rahman
  - security/compliance claim questions → Marcus Lin / Olga Petrov
- Success thresholds (initial; confirm with SRE):
  - P95 purchase→entitlement active < 15 minutes
  - webhook failure rate < 0.5% over 1h window
  - org linking success rate > 98% (excluding invalid user input)

Open questions
- AWS vs GCP launch coupling: do we require simultaneous go-live, or allow staggered launch by up to 1–2 weeks based on review lead time?
- What is our public-facing SLA for entitlement activation time in docs (if any)? We should be careful; partner delays happen.
- Do we want to run a limited pilot with 1–2 friendly customers before broad announcement?

Acceptance criteria
- Launch plan doc shared in #marketplace-refresh and linked from the marketplace review checklist.
- Sales/SE enablement session delivered with recording + FAQs; attendance from Sales/SE/CS required roles.
- Support macros created and added to runbook; first-line triage path confirmed.
- Docs publish completed, links verified from listings + console, and redirects/nav updated.
- Dashboards/alerts live and validated with synthetic staging events; on-call runbook published.
- Post-launch review scheduled (T+3 to T+7 days) with initial metrics and top issues.

References
- Marketplace review checklist (Drive): marketplace-review-checklist.json
- Launch brief draft (Drive): marketplace-launch-brief-draft.json
- Security FAQ (Confluence): marketplace-security-faq-aws-gcp.json
- Onboarding design spec (Confluence): marketplace-purchase-to-provisioning-onboarding-flow.json
